fixture.description: Rotation (spec §6.8) by the tenant with `lease_request.rotate` as its body: it presents the lease's CURRENT token and names `next`. The provider stores `next` in place of the old token and persists the lease before it answers. The answer is `{ workload_id, rotated: true }` and carries no token. From here the old token is `not_tenant` and every grant derived from it is `bad_grant` (`error.not_tenant.rotated`, `error.bad_grant.rotated`), while `next` reads the lease (`status.rotated`). There is no grace period and nothing is published.
